SELECT LAST_ORDER_ID AS ID FROM ID_SEQUENCE
INSERT INTO CUSTOMER (CUSTOMER_NAME, EMAIL, REGION_CODE) VALUES (?, ?, ?)
sqlMap.update: UPDATE CUSTOMER SET EMAIL = #email#, UPDATED_AT = #updatedAt# WHERE CUSTOMER_ID = #customerId#
UPDATE CUSTOMER SET STATUS = 'CLOSED', UPDATED_AT = #updatedAt# WHERE CUSTOMER_ID NOT IN (SELECT O.CUSTOMER_ID FROM ORDERS O WHERE O.STATUS = 'COMPLETED')
sqlMap.delete: DELETE FROM ORDER_DETAIL WHERE ORDER_ID IN (SELECT O.ORDER_ID FROM ORDERS O WHERE O.STATUS = #status#)
sqlMap.insert: INSERT INTO ARCHIVED_CUSTOMER (CUSTOMER_ID, CUSTOMER_NAME, ARCHIVED_AT) SELECT C.CUSTOMER_ID, C.CUSTOMER_NAME, #archivedAt# FROM CUSTOMER C WHERE C.STATUS = 'CLOSED'
